mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dish_ingredient (id, dish_id, ingredient_id, weight, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.dishId}, #{item.ingredientId}, #{item.weight}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT di.id, di.dish_id, di.ingredient_id, di.weight, di.create_time, i.name as ingredientName FROM dish_ingredient di LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON di.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE di.dish_id = #{dishId} ORDER BY di.create_time
